backstory:
Marco Dubois is Giuseppi Pesci Sr. 's childhood friend. They’ve been through everything together. Obviously, he was the best man at Giuseppi’s wedding and is the godfather of Giuseppi Jr. 


In his youth, Marco Dubois got in a fist fight with Giuseppi over some stupid argument neither of them remember. Afterwards, they were forced by their parents to apologize and make up, then they became best friends. Inseparable.


Unlike Giuseppi, Marco doesn’t want to make a living through a life of crime. Marco never found something he was truly passionate about and tried many jobs for a few years after school. Eventually, he decided to become a mailman, because of the benefits and the inherent exercise that comes along with it. Although he doesn’t feel like he could support a family on a mailman’s salary, Marco has been saving his salary for years in the hopes that he can find a suitable wife to start a family with.


Marco is a bit too prideful to ask Giuseppi for help finding a wife, otherwise he’d have been married for years by now.


Marco will always listen to Giuseppi’s problem under one condition, Giuseppi needs to buy and split a family pizza meal with him. Those garlic breads are to die for.
